solution_sketch: At 3:30 the minute hand is at 180° (pointing at 6). The hour hand has drifted half an hour past 3, so it sits at 3.5 × 30° = 105°. The gap is 180° − 105° = 75°.
difficulty_rationale: Naive route: read 3:30 as 'minute at 6, hour at 3' and answer 90° from the arc 3→6. That is the wrong-but-tempting number this puzzle is built around. Insight: the hour hand moves continuously at 0.5°/min, so by :30 it has slid to 105°. One subtraction gives 75°. The move (hour hand isn't stationary) is common knowledge, not memorised trivia, so it's findable cold in a few seconds — but the trap answer 90° is what most people say first.
